execution_environment.model: Client default; exact served model version was not explicitly pinned or recorded.

comparison_design.followup: Three newly authored confirmation requests under the final freeze, plus a repeat of the original work-routing probe. The repeat is not unseen confirmation.
comparison_design.dependencies: Cases within each five-case batch share context. They are not independent repeated runs, and per-case reference application is model-reported.
comparison_design.catalog_boundary: Catalog entries are model-reported, not a complete independently enumerated catalog. Observed entry reads and matching hashes identify the selected method.
comparison_design.reads_boundary: Trace reads are trial-level observed file opens. Per-case applied-reference claims are self-reports; neither establishes runtime enforcement.

baseline.hash_scope: Public method allowlist only; paths are relative to the Mob Write root. Documentation and behavior results are outside this method content hash.
baseline.verification: Each listed frozen-source and isolated-installed file was independently SHA-256 checked against the public installation receipt.

candidate.verification: Each listed frozen-source and isolated-installed file was independently SHA-256 checked against the public installation receipt.
candidate.freeze_method: Frozen public files before behavior runs; current sources must match before commit.

followup.hash_scope: Public method allowlist only; paths are relative to the Mob Write root. Documentation and behavior results are outside this method content hash.
